mapper.sql: r.id as rabbit_id, r.house_id, r.cage_id, c.cage_number, c.row_code, c.layer_index, c.position_index, c.is_enabled as cage_enabled, r.type as rabbit_type, r.gender, r.weight, r.is_active as active, r.is_quarantined as quarantined, r.state_version, br.batch_id, br.current_status as stage, br.next_event_date, br.next_event_type, exists(select 1 from treatment_records tr where tr.house_id = r.house_id and tr.rabbit_id = r.id and tr.status = 'OPEN') as open_treatment, exists(select 1 from rabbit_abnormal_conditions ac where ac.house_id = r.house_id and ac.rabbit_id = r.id and ac.is_deal = false) as unresolved_abnormal

from rabbits r left join cages c on c.id = r.cage_id and c.house_id = r.house_id left join batch_rabbits br on br.id = ( select br2.id from batch_rabbits br2 inner join batches b2 on b2.id = br2.batch_id and b2.house_id = r.house_id where br2.rabbit_id = r.id and br2.is_active = true order by br2.id desc limit 1 )
